name: mobile/cascade
description: A mobile-first stepwise picker that shows the selected path as vertical steps and a scrollable option list for the current level. Tap a step to re-choose from that level; drill into children until a leaf is selected.
useCases: Category trees such as department, product type, and SKU on a phone-sized form
Address pickers that walk region, city, and district one level at a time
Classification flows where the user should see the committed path while choosing the next level
Any hierarchical single-path selection that should fill its container instead of a fixed height
